text:
Nils Hoglander needed a change of scenery, and Nashville has been good for him. After 331 games in Vancouver, including 5 points in 38 games last season, he has 5 goals and 10 points in 24 games as a Predator, on 11:28 a night.

Some of it is real. His own chances are up to 1.09 expected goals per 60 from 0.47 last season, more than double, and his 5 goals match his 5.02 expected goals almost exactly. Nashville wins 54.3% of the expected goals (chance quality) at five on five with him, about eight points better than without him.

Some of it is the team. The Predators have scored 6.3 more goals than expected with him on the ice, and his 2.18 points per 60 sit at the top of our talent range. Evolving-Hockey noted he played with weak teammates last season, bottom 4% by their impact, which made his Vancouver numbers look worse than his own effect. Nashville has won eight of his last ten games. A second-round pick who once scored 11 points at a World Juniors is playing like a useful NHL forward again.
headline: Hoglander found a fresh start
